newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai utility firm sets share offer price at 30 bah. [CORRECTED 5:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thai utility firm sets share offer price at 30 bah. [CORRECTED 5:30 GMT]

text.p: Thai utility firm Eastern Water Resources Development and Management Plc, said on Monday that it had set its share public offering price at 30 baht per share.
Eastern Water said in a statement that 41.6 million shares will be offered to local investors, while 9.4 million shares will be floated to international investors.
Thai Investment and Securities Plc and Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc are the lead underwriters for the domestic portions.
ABN AMRO Rothschild is responsible for the international offerings, it said.
The shares will be opened for retail investors' subscription between June 18 and 20, the company said.

Eastern Water, which is the operator of water utility for industry in the eastern part of Thailand, is majority owned by the state-owned Metropolitan Electricity Authority and the Industrial Estate Authority of Thailand.
